description: A bass part under the phrase. At 90 BPM, for four bars, the course project at this stage plays the phrase of C3, C3, C3 and a softer D3 on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13, plus a second channel playing a bass at velocity 100, C2 on step 1 and G2 on step 9, each one step long. Listen for a low note arriving with the first C3 and answering at the half bar, under the melody.
